player_prompt.intro:
Waxaad u tahay Ciyaartoyga {player_id} ee **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Gudbi halagaaga sida **[macro  micro]** (lambaro laba ah 0-8):
• *macro*  = goobta mini ee aad ciyaarto
• *micro* = goobta ku jirta goobta mini
Tusaale `[7 8]` ➜ ku qor alaabtaada goobta mini 7, goobta 8, oo
khasaasha ciyaartoygaaga bannaanka ugu ciyaaro goobta mini 8 inay soo socoto.

Waxaad u tahay `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Guuritaanka waa inuu ahaadaa nooca [macro micro] oo leh tirooyinka 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Heerka waxqabadka waa inuu u dhexeeyaa 0 ilaa 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Baarka yar, safka ama tiirka waa ka baxsan yihiin.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Ciyaaryahanka waa inuu ku ciyaaraa shaxda mikro-ka xiga.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Goobta mini waa hadda la guuleystay.

next_board.any: wax kasta oo micro board ah

game_action.played: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu ku ciyaaray micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Ciyaaryahanka {opponent_id} waa inuu hadda ku ciyaaraa {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ayaa ku guuleysta Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
